title: Conditional kappa 0.001393662920776407: blockwise pair exposure, 99 pivots and whole-owner allocation
body:
## Result

This constructs and independently replays a new complex supplier giving conditional **kappa = 0.001393662920776407**, exactly `1393662920776407/1000000000000000000`. It improves our preceding checked construction, 0.001391523459591829, by **0.153750%**. The complex side binds at `b = 697803963898659915203/500000000000000000000000`; the unchanged cited PR493 bit supplier has `c = 391360506745414227149/250000000000000000000000`.

The inherited all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-basis interface, normalized Lemma A realization, restored-row, precision/tape and analytic-transfer contracts remain dependencies. This is not an unconditional multiplication theorem or new Lean certification. Larger submissions with different or disputed interfaces are not treated as comparable verified baselines.

## New mechanism

Instead of using a uniform pair choice throughout the local fourteen-block factory, choose pairs blockwise and reconstruct the exact downstream decoder. The selected witness uses option [0,0] everywhere except blocks (0,2,4,6) and (0,3,4,7), where it uses [1,1]. This changes the exposed intermediate rows, rather than merely changing coordinates within an identical response class.

The construction retains the preceding four coordinated rank-two gauge reductions and compatible scalar-body retiming. Exact response reduction now yields **99 cancellations rather than 92**. The local paid profile is `{1:2530,2:182,3:516,4:88,5:298,6:68,7:1,8:17}`; residual widths are `{7:18,8:161,9:381}`.

Constructive width-dominance transport and pattern exchange then produce a new literal whole-owner allocation. Eight replicas retain the complete-invocation order `(7*stage+6*replica, stage, replica)`. All 40,320 helper uses have explicit legal owners, and every remaining pending factor is paid. The complete global profile is `{1:182160,2:13104,3:40196,4:6336,5:25064,6:4896,7:164,8:1224,48:796}`. Ambient dimension 73, live stock 7,680, physical stock 8,258 and rank deficit 2,496 are unchanged.

No helper is split across owners, no scalar instruction crosses an unfinished invocation, and headline gains are not added.

## Four OpenAI-source research routes

The appendix preserves mathematical rules, source hashes and bounded experiments from four distinct proof families in OpenAI math at adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a:

1. HoneycombChords sparse interpolation/Newton evaluation inspired blockwise exposure choices and exact decoder reconstruction; this contributes to the selected word.
2. MatchingCount unit flow/mincut and perfect matching inspired constructive ownership transport and pattern exchange. The new allocation contributes; the separate cut-guided scheduling experiment did not win.
3. ThinTrees rational Schur history inspired paid internal-register elimination. Four finite screens found no legal cheaper witness.
4. QuantumCircuit pruning inspired the exact sufficient condition `(U-I)R=0` on all reachable input columns. Both orientations of the new program have 3,700 positive child sites; no zero-operand candidate survived modular screening.

These are source-inspired adaptations, not four imported Lean theorems or four numerical gains. No global originality claim is inferred from the search. Alternative losing architectures and the sufficient conditions for future use are documented rather than counted as savings.

## Reproduce and validation

From `research/nodal-pair-async`, with Python 3.11 or later and assertions enabled:

```text
python -B verify.py --work /absolute/path/to/a-new-output-directory
```

Standard library only; no network, optimizer, C++ compiler or Lean required. Fourteen stages rebuild the word, check all 800 arbitrary-dirt columns in both orientations and 99 correction-omission controls, verify exact Gaussian phases and physical wrappers, audit all whole owners and remainders, recount the finite invoice, and execute two rational moment engines and all 47 strict outer constraints. Adjacent-price and invalid assembly controls are rejected.

The actual scalar envelope requires 21 local prefix bits and 206 global bits, below the retained charge of 512. The inherited meaningful owner-alias control remains in place. A full fresh replay passed with every recognized package text file converted to CRLF. Missing inputs, changed tokens and optimized Python are rejected before output creation. No hidden file is required; LF/CRLF normalization does not ignore any other content. No Linux or Python 3.14 execution is claimed from this Windows test.

The package includes the exact expected result, complete assembly receipt, portability receipt, source credits and research appendix. Nothing has been published by the tooling.
